I understand Darius may not have intended to exclude me, and I'm not here to assign malice. But the impact has been real: I've been left out of decisions that directly affect my deliverables, and it's happened more than once. I do want this resolved constructively, and I'm willing to share what I've documented if that helps the process.

commitments.detail: Interim safeguards will ensure Leah is included in all decisions connected to her work and is not interrupted or excluded from meetings where her deliverables are discussed, effective immediately and lasting through the resolution process.

A neutral facilitator outside the reporting chain for both Leah and Darius will be selected by Simone. Elena will not serve as facilitator given her prior informal conversations with Darius and her position as line manager.
Darius will be offered a separate preparation meeting before the facilitated resolution session so he can prepare a direct and meaningful apology to Leah.
A written no-retaliation notice will be issued to both Leah and Darius as required by the applicable resolution procedure.
A formal follow-up check-in will be conducted by Simone exactly 14 days after the resolution meeting, as required by the resolution procedure.

Elena's informal arrangement for Jon to conduct Darius's weekly check-ins for 30 days will be formalized as an interim safeguard. These check-ins are not disciplinary monitoring. This arrangement is separate from the formal resolution procedure and will be documented in the case file.
Leah is encouraged to submit her documented account of the three specific incidents through the appropriate channel so it becomes part of the official case record.

Martin will add the procedural guidance regarding the resolution path, neutral facilitator requirement, no-retaliation notice, and 14-day follow-up to Simone's case notes after this meeting so the record is complete.
